_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::heat#3 — the three scatra mesh routes and the trap that a geometry section naming the wrong field is caught by nothing. Four arms on a 3-D HEX8 heat deck. (1) The inline route (NODE COORDS + TRANSPORT ELEMENTS + D*-NODE TOPOLOGY) needs no geometry section and no external file: exit 0. (2) 'THERMO GEOMETRY' — the section a heat problem tempts you into — is a perfectly valid section name and is never read for the scatra field: the run exits 0 although the missing_mesh.exo it names does not exist (THERMO_GEOM_TOUCHED_THE_FILE=0, THERMO_GEOM_SECTION_NAME_REJECTED=0), so writing it instead of TRANSPORT GEOMETRY produces no message at all. (3) 'TRANSPORT GEOMETRY' IS the scatra route, and alongside the inline section 4C aborts from core/io/src/4C_io_meshreader.cpp with "Multiple options to read mesh for discretization 'scatra'. Only one is allowed." and lists 'TRANSPORT ELEMENTS' 'TRANSPORT GEOMETRY'. (4) 'HEAT GEOMETRY' is not a field, so the name itself is rejected. The string an earlier version of this entry quoted, 'expected element category TRANSP but got SOLID', appears in none of the four logs. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Multiple options to read mesh for discretization 'scatra'. Only one is allowed.
Section 'HEAT GEOMETRY' is not a valid section name.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from arm 2: point the misdirected block at the scatra field instead. It then collides with the inline mesh and aborts, EXIT_THERMO becomes 1 and the fixture must go red — the silence exists only while the section names a field this problem does not have.
remove the pathology from arm 4: use a field name that exists. The 'not a valid section name' line disappears and the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from arm 3: drop the competing route. The mesh-reader abort and the list of offending section names both disappear and the fixture must go red.
